steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: EVERYONE!! ARE YOU READY?!!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: The greatest collaborative concert of the Obsidian Festival will begin in just three hours!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: WOOOOOOOOOO!!!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: It's about time. As long as Schwarz and Rhodes Island can fight each other to a standstill, things will go smoothly here.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I knew pitting them against each other would be a masterful move. Heh.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Hurry up! Move these things out of here! Pick up the pace, or you won't be seeing your paychecks!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Hmm? What's that sound coming from outside?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor, if we just rush into the broadcast tower, I'm sure we'll run straight into Cronin's ambush.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If we move together, Schwarz will definitely try to disarm your forces first, and I won't be able to contain her at all.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Even if we seize the broadcast tower by force, without the support of the government, my words will only confuse the public and cause panic.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If Schwarz is protecting Cronin, that will prove to be a major obstacle for you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Most importantly, you'll have to figure out a way to find out whatever Cronin is hiding.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Maybe Cronin really is innocent, but...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: In that case, we'd just force him to announce the news?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Right. If that's what it boils down to, I don't mind using force, since I was thinking the same thing.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: That takes some guts, Miss Ceylon. Maybe even borders on reckless.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Rhodes Island has already proven my conclusion through their lab tests. If I don't do this, countless lives are going to be lost here.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I'm not trying to blame you, Miss. I just don't get to decide whether Rhodes Island can go along with your plan.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Do you mean...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Doctor. You should be well aware of our options as well as their consequences. What should we do?

options: We've already come this far. There's only one thing to do!
Letting countless innocents suffer violates our credo.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: So, who will take responsibility for this?

options: Nobody, as long as no-one finds out.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: That's our Doctor.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Miss Ceylon, let's go before it's too late.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor...

options: Do what you have to do.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I understand. I'll hold Schwarz back.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Besides, there's something I must do. I need to know the answer...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Why are you pushing me away?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, you've received an education in Victoria. You belong somewhere better. Don't stay here and struggle with people like us.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...No. I don't agree with that.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz, what do you think I see you as? And what do you think of me as?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I am not the person you think I am, milady.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Because you've killed someone?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Because you've killed many people?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, milady. That's enough.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Perhaps we're both mistaken, Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I don't want you to know about that, milady!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Milady?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I already know. I've already heard about your past... even if it's just a little bit of it.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm sorry if you didn't want me to learn about it, but I can't just feign ignorance.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, milady! You're not supposed to know that! You should have...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I should have what? Kept doing what was expected of me? Kept studying hard, and then rise to the upper class? As if!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm not some delicate flower, nor am I an ignorant little princess! I have something that I must do!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: All of us have a responsibility to protect Siesta. You and I, and my father as well! None of us are bystanders!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You didn't want me to get involved in this in order to protect me, right?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, I...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You're just like my father. Trying to dictate everything for me because it's 'for my own good,' but I don't think so!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So what if what I'm doing is dangerous? So what if you have a dark past?! Maybe I'll cry or be terrified or even be hurt by these things...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But if you ever say 'Ceylon, I need your help,' I'll always be there for you! No matter what you have to say, I'll always lend you my ear!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If we really are friends, then we should do that for each other. How can we be considered friends when you're the only one doing the giving?!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, Schwarz, would you help me right now?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You asked me before why I'm doing this. And this is my answer...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, would you give me your response, Schwarz? If what happened in the past is truly in the past, could you be my friend again, just like before?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady... I'm sorry. I'm sorry for what I've done and said. My actions have caused a misunderstanding between us that never should have happened...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, you are my friend. And you always have been.

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: Are you two still chit-chatting? What's the verdict? What's going on over there?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, please tell me, what are we going to do next?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Huh? I, um... I'd like to spread the news about the impending Catastrophe through official channels.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Rhodes Island should be collecting evidence against Cronin as we speak, and he'll soon be kicked out of the City Council...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: However, after the news gets out, the Obsidian Festival will have to be canceled, and Siesta will have to move...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Don't worry, milady.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: R-really?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: If that's what you desire, then I will support you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, do you need me to protect you?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Mm, yes.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: In that case, please take cover. It'll be over soon.

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: Schwarz, what are you doing? Are you disobeying Cronin's orders?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Orders? Support Cronin? That's just a disguise. Since the very beginning, I've only had two orders.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: First, Master Doykos asked me to collect evidence against Cronin, including his secret manipulation of V3 Industries and his unauthorized harvesting of obsidian.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Now that the truth has come to light, the gig is up.

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: G-get them, quickly! Seize both of them, now!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: As for the second order, you just heard it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Milady asked me to protect her.
